# Ezekiel 18 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-the-word-of YHWH came to-me, saying:

**2** "What [is it]-to-you — you [who]-use this proverb upon the-land-of Israel, saying, 'Fathers eat sour-grapes, and-the-teeth-of the-children are-set-on-edge'?

**3** As-I-live," declares the-Lord YHWH, "there-will-not-be to-you anymore [the]-using-of this proverb in-Israel.

**4** Behold, all the-souls — to-Me they [are]; as-the-soul-of the-father, so also the-soul-of the-son — to-Me they [are]. The-soul that-sins — she shall-die.

**5** And-a-man who is righteous and-does justice and-righteousness —

**6** upon the-mountains he-has-not-eaten, and-his-eyes he-has-not-lifted to the-idols-of the-house-of Israel, and-the-wife-of his-neighbor he-has-not-defiled, and-to a-woman in-her-impurity he-has-not-drawn-near,

**7** and-a-man he-has-not-oppressed, his-pledge for-a-debt he-has-returned, robbery he-has-not-robbed, his-bread to-the-hungry he-has-given, and-the-naked he-has-covered [with] a-garment,

**8** at-interest he-has-not-given, and-increase he-has-not-taken, from-injustice he-has-turned-back his-hand, judgment-of truth he-has-done between man and-man,

**9** in-My-statutes he-has-walked and-My-judgments he-has-kept, to-do truth — righteous he [is]; living he-shall-live," declares the-Lord YHWH.

**10** "And-he-begets a-son [who is] violent, a-shedder-of blood, and-does to-a-brother any-of-these [wrongs] —

**11** and-he — all these he-has-done — dying he-shall-die; his-blood shall-be upon-him.

**12** and-he — all these he-has-done — dying he-shall-die; his-blood shall-be upon-him.

**13** and-he — all these he-has-done — dying he-shall-die; his-blood shall-be upon-him.

**14** and-he — all these he-has-done — dying he-shall-die; his-blood shall-be upon-him.

**15** and-he — all these he-has-done — dying he-shall-die; his-blood shall-be upon-him.

**16** and-he — all these he-has-done — dying he-shall-die; his-blood shall-be upon-him.

**17** and-he — all these he-has-done — dying he-shall-die; his-blood shall-be upon-him.

**18** [As for] his-father — because he-practiced extortion, robbed-robbery [from] a-brother, and-what [was]-not-good he-did in-the-midst-of his-people — behold, he-dies in-his-iniquity.

**19** "And-you-say, 'Why does-not the-son bear the-iniquity-of the-father?' And-the-son — justice and-righteousness he-has-done, all My-statutes he-has-kept and-done-them — living he-shall-live.

**20** The-soul that-sins — she shall-die. A-son shall-not-bear the-iniquity-of the-father, and-a-father shall-not-bear the-iniquity-of the-son; the-righteousness-of the-righteous shall-be upon-him, and-the-wickedness-of the-wicked shall-be upon-him.

**21** And-the-wicked — if he-turns from-all his-sins which he-has-done, and-keeps all My-statutes, and-does justice and-righteousness — living he-shall-live; he-shall-not-die.

**22** All his-transgressions which he-did shall-not-be-remembered against-him; in-his-righteousness which he-has-done he-shall-live.

**23** Do-I-take-pleasure, yes-pleasure, in-the-death-of the-wicked?" declares the-Lord YHWH. "Is-it-not in-his-turning from-his-ways and-he-lives?

**24** And-in-the-turning-of [the]-righteous from-his-righteousness and-doing injustice, according-to all the-abominations which the-wicked does — shall-he-do and-live? All his-righteous-deeds which he-did shall-not-be-remembered; in-his-unfaithfulness which-he-acted-unfaithfully and-in-his-sin which he-sinned — in-them he-shall-die.

**25** "And-you-say, 'The-way-of the-Lord is-not-right.' Hear, please, house-of Israel: Is-My-way not-right? Is-it-not your-ways [that are] not-right?

**26** "Therefore each-man according-to his-ways I-will-judge-you, house-of Israel," declares the-Lord YHWH. "Return! And-turn-back from-all your-transgressions, and-it-will-not-be to-you a-stumbling-block-of iniquity."

**27** "Therefore each-man according-to his-ways I-will-judge-you, house-of Israel," declares the-Lord YHWH. "Return! And-turn-back from-all your-transgressions, and-it-will-not-be to-you a-stumbling-block-of iniquity."

**28** "Therefore each-man according-to his-ways I-will-judge-you, house-of Israel," declares the-Lord YHWH. "Return! And-turn-back from-all your-transgressions, and-it-will-not-be to-you a-stumbling-block-of iniquity."

**29** "Therefore each-man according-to his-ways I-will-judge-you, house-of Israel," declares the-Lord YHWH. "Return! And-turn-back from-all your-transgressions, and-it-will-not-be to-you a-stumbling-block-of iniquity."

**30** "Therefore each-man according-to his-ways I-will-judge-you, house-of Israel," declares the-Lord YHWH. "Return and-turn-back from-all your-transgressions, and-iniquity shall-not-be to-you a-stumbling-block.

**31** Cast-away from-upon-you all your-transgressions which you-transgressed in-them, and-make for-yourselves a-heart new and-a-spirit new; and-why shall-you-die, house-of Israel?

**32** For I-take-no-pleasure in-the-death-of the-one-dying," declares the-Lord YHWH. "So-turn and-live!"

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **18:2**: Avot akhelu boser ve-shinei ha-banim tiqhenah — 'Fathers eat sour grapes and the children's teeth are set on edge.' The proverb (also Jer 31:29) claims collective punishment. Ezekiel demolishes it: each generation is accountable.

- **18:4**: Ha-nefesh ha-chotet hi tamut — 'the soul that sins, she shall die.' The foundational principle of individual accountability. Nefesh here means the whole person, not a disembodied soul.

- **18:31**: Lev chadash ve-ruach chadashah — 'a new heart and a new spirit.' Here the command falls on Israel; in 36:26, God promises to do it Himself. The tension between human responsibility and divine initiative runs through Ezekiel.

— EMET
